hypothesis: W-R39's histogram and top16 sorted bit-XOR summaries were exactly encoding invariant but near chance. Preserve temporal slot position in a 16-dimensional ordered state under unchanged readout parameter count and budget; compare lag1 and lag2 transition residuals against the frozen repeated-scalar baseline.
freeze: Before first-use pin fresh dev seeds1856..1871, sealed heldout1872..1887, same 4-bit sensor quantizer and XOR55 recoding, three generators, two test swap sites, original W-R39 model training rules, 32 epochs, 1728 balanced examples per arm and pass criteria. Do not select arm or alter thresholds after outcome.
arms: scalar_repeated: exact W-R39 XOR-invariant top-two residual repeated 16 times
ordered_lag1: each of 16 state slots is the sum of four channel popcounts of XOR-of-reference-vs-observation differences across the tick and its next neighbor
ordered_lag2: each slot similarly pools four channel popcounts using neighbor tick plus two; physical time order remains unshuffled

training.source: Original pinned W-R39 affine_prior paired generator

criterion: POSITIONAL_ROBUST_UTILITY iff either ordered arm has identity and XOR55 heldout accuracy >=0.65 and improves repeated scalar by >=0.10; PARTIAL_GAIN iff any ordered arm improves by >=0.05; NO_GAIN otherwise. All 16-slot features must be exactly invariant under same XOR55 applied to raw reference and observed candidate; violation invalidates original execution.
controls: Identical paired train/test input and 16 numerical weights plus bias, identical fixed epochs and train order; arms differ only in source-prespecified representation
Disclose effective hypothesis-class expansion from per-time observations even without numeric capacity increase
